hub.label: Site health: when a line turns yellow
hub.help: The Site health page shows one line each for customer problems, the server, speed, the site audit and the smoke test. A line turns yellow when the server's health check is later than these minutes, the home page answers slower than these milliseconds, or the last smoke test is older than these hours. It only changes how the lines are judged, nothing on the server.

journeys.label: Site health: when the saved journeys run
journeys.help: The saved browser journeys (a customer, the admin, an accountant and the warehouse, on a phone and a desktop screen) are replayed on this schedule: hourly, daily or weekly at the hour chosen, in the server's time zone. Off as it ships: then they run only when someone presses Run now. The customer journey never puts anything in the bag and never places an order. The server keeps this many runs for comparison.

problems.label: Site health: the customer problem recorder
problems.help: The shop's pages report what goes wrong for a visitor — a script error, a failed or slow call to the shop's server, a page that failed, the error screen, a form field refused again and again, rage clicks, broken pictures and slow loads — never a name, phone, address or payment detail (visitor ids are random). The same cause becomes one problem on Reports › Site health › Customer problems. The numbers decide what is slow, what counts as a rage click or a stuck form, how many reports one page may send, when a problem is Urgent, how many days the lists show, and what is a short glitch.

alerts.label: Site health: Telegram alerts for customer problems
alerts.help: A line to the owner's Telegram (Keys & connections) when a customer problem needs him now: when a problem becomes Urgent, or when one problem hit this many visitors within these minutes. At most one line per problem within the hours set. Off as it ships; nothing is blocked or changed in the shop.
